description_en: Associates a user VPC and vSwitches with a 5G Cloud Connector instance
description_zh: 关联用户Vpc和Vswitch到5G高速上云实例
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g attach-vpc-to-net-link --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --net-link-id cciot-xxxx --vpc-id vpc-bp1etmgc4vooo5ahbkzou --vswitches vsw-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachVpcToNetLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G Cloud Connector instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network connectivity
parameters.name: net_link_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitches in the user VPC. You must specify two vSwitches to configure active/standby redundancy. The zones of the vSwitches must be the same as the zone of the network connectivity
parameters.help_zh: 客户的专有网络下的交换机，必须是2个进行主备，且交换机的可用区和和网络连接的可用区保持一致
parameters.name: vswitches

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without associating the user VPC and vSwitches. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and associates the user VPC and vSwitches with the 5G Cloud Connector instance if the request passes the dry run
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会关联用户Vpc和Vswitch。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后关联用户Vpc和Vswitch到5G高速上云实例
parameters.name: dry_run
